notes: A REMITTANCE CAN BE POINTED AT THE CHEQUE THAT ACTUALLY PAID IT. THE COMPLAINT. The dashboard reports a ledger check failure that no amount of reconciling will clear: cheque 969916 settled 952.00 of remittances but is registered at 847.00, difference 105.00, reconcile in Cheque Register. Nothing is wrong with the money. One cheque for 952.00 to GRA covered two VAT withholding remittances. The app writes one cheque row per remittance voucher and refuses a duplicate number, so the register carries that cheque as two rows, 847.00 and 105.00, which is how every split cheque is held here and the bank clears such a pair as a single line under the base number. What was wrong was one record: the 105.00 deduction was noted against the base number instead of the row that carries it, so the schedule read 952.00 against a row registered at 847.00. CORRECT CHEQUE NO. An administrator can now point a remitted deduction at the cheque row that actually paid it, from the Withholding Payables list. It asks which cheque, and why, and the reason goes on the audit trail with the number it moved from and to. It changes THE RECORD ONLY: no ledger entry is made, no amount and no date moves, and no reconciliation's arithmetic changes. On the ledger this was written for, the unpresented total at 31 July is the same figure to the penny before and after. It will NOT point a deduction at a cheque that is not on the register, because that would trade one problem for a worse one: the schedule would then show money settled against no register row at all, and the reconciliation would never carry it. If the cheque was genuinely never registered, register it first, and the dashboard says so in those words when that is the case. WHY IT IS NOT BLOCKED ON A SIGNED OFF MONTH. Every other change to the register is refused if it would re-state a month you have signed off. This one is not, for the same reason correcting a cheque NUMBER is not: a number is not a figure. It moves no amount and no date, so nothing a signed month reported can change, and every signed version now keeps the schedules it was filed with, so what that month said stays exactly as it was said. Without that the tool would be useless for the thing it exists to fix, because a remittance noted against the wrong cheque is almost always one sitting in a month already closed. INSTALLING: no data changes and no ledger entries. This installs straight over the previous version. Please still take a backup first: Backup and Export, Back up now.
